releases.localizedDescription:
#### This is release for:
  - version: "0.6.4-20260904.55+3fc1e3d2"
  - revision: "3fc1e3d2"
  - timestamp: "Fri Sep  4 05:36:32 2026"

#### What's Changed:
- Merge pull request #27 from The-Big-Mini/MiniStoreFork
- Merge remote-tracking branch 'upstream/develop' into MiniStoreFork
- added support for viewing mach-O + embedded.mobileprovision info dumps
- updated dependencies to latest
- added mach-O parser display in bundle browser of app-info view
- updated dev portal screen title
- fix the revoke alert button color
- add more words so that the revoke alert shows buttons stacked instead of cramped on same row
- make revoke alert skip for paid accts since they can create new certs and not always need to revoke at least 1 existing as free accts
- make revoke alert scrollable
- added version number priting in console log header
- fix: fetch profiles was not properly sanitizing name (apollo reborn uses widget name with parenthesis for word `(legacy)` causing server rejection) + was swallowing errors from sidesign's direct server call errors
- fix: removed ddi mount from minimuxer start and restrict it to only debugApp() api
- cleanup all other left over error types
- rework operations logging
- cleanup unused errors
- cleanup: removed unused errors in minimuxer and replaced with original wherever possible
- cleanup the minimuxer wrapper's unused error extensions
- cleanup: ditch wrapper extension for minimuxerError since minimuxer layer error handling is more robust and we dont wanna mask it with app level extension wrapper
- fix the minimuxer tcp connection probing + pairing file handling sequence
- fix: appboot sequence for startminimuxer after loading pairing file was incorrect
- added diag logging for the testDeviceConnection
- updated submodule to latest - fixes the codesign issues within sidesign/codesignkit
- logging improvements and updated submodules to latest
- updated to latest
- cleanup timestamp method to remove unused formatter input
- added fast formatter + remove massive binary bloat which was due to inlining log calls
- added fast formatter + remove massive binary bloat which was due to inlining log calls
- fix toast on portal services + fixes for appgrp/devices detail view not showing data
- implement portal services access
- moved some things around for readability
- fetch profiles is a single operation

apps.name: MiniStore
apps.subtitle: SideStore with UI upgrades and preloaded sources
apps.localizedDescription:
MiniStore is SideStore with the interface sanded down.

Everything SideStore does, MiniStore does — it sideloads apps onto your device with just an Apple ID, resigns them with your personal development certificate, and refreshes them in the background so the 7-day development period never expires.

What it adds:

• OLED dark mode — true black throughout, applied live without a relaunch.
• Accent colour theming — presets or a custom colour, across every tab and the home screen widget.
• Reorganised settings — a list of categories instead of one long scroll.
• Tab customization — hide the tabs you don't use and choose which one opens on launch.
• What's New — release notes read straight from GitHub.
• A preloaded catalogue so there is something to browse immediately.

MiniStore is a thin layer on top of SideStore, kept deliberately small so upstream releases can be merged in as they land.
